answer: Hash-commitment work lottery: before each deadline every agent publishes a hash of its task output, unchangeable afterwards. After reveal, three random peers re-run each task against its commitment; a mismatch or an echo of another output is rejected, rewards frozen three epochs, repeat failures tightening the audit spiral. A farm of 1,000 fakes cannot clone one solution across identities: each needs its own pre-committed hash, so it must run 1,000 genuine tasks, about 333 GPU-hours per epoch. One honest agent commits one hash, runs one task, pays nothing, and lets its work wander uncopied.
